language_contract.claim_boundary: A language is not advertised as pure or quality-verified until it has local fixture, digital audio, licence, and native-review evidence.

portability_contract.claim_boundary: A listed provider or target does not prove it has executed on that target.

delivery_contract.streaming: The stream endpoint emits bounded chunks only after complete local synthesis and optional cleanup. It is not incremental model inference.

tools.name: nastech_list_providers
tools.description: List the Nastech 60-provider catalog and truthful activation states.

tools.name: nastech_list_languages
tools.description: List Bantu-language targets with evidence states and provider routes.

tools.name: nastech_language_preflight
tools.description: Inspect a language target's provider, licence, native-review, and activation requirements without side effects.

tools.name: nastech_list_language_packs
tools.description: List lazy Bantu model-pack cache and download states without downloading models.

tools.name: nastech_download_language_pack
tools.description: Download exactly one requested Bantu language pack into the external cache.

tools.name: nastech_provider_preflight
tools.description: Create a zero-side-effect activation plan for one Nastech provider target.

tools.name: nastech_compose_story
tools.description: Compose a deterministic English Nastech Agent story and optionally render it locally.

tools.name: nastech_plan_speech
tools.description: Compile NastechML for an explicitly selected local provider and registered language without generating audio.

tools.name: nastech_compile_speech
tools.description: Compile NastechML into a provider- and language-aware request with a fidelity manifest.

tools.name: nastech_generate_speech
tools.description: Generate completed local WAV audio through an active Nastech provider that declares the selected language.

tools.name: nastech_stream_speech
tools.description: Transfer a completed local WAV in bounded post-synthesis chunks; not incremental inference.

tools.name: nastech_clean_wav
tools.description: Apply deterministic local PCM hygiene to mono signed-16-bit WAV audio.

tools.name: nastech_list_platforms
tools.description: Report host facts, registered ONNX providers, and verified or planned portability profiles.

tools.name: nastech_platform_preflight
tools.description: Build a CPU, GPU, mobile, or browser activation plan with evidence requirements.

tools.name: nastech_runtime_diagnostics
tools.description: Read local CPU policy, model state, cache state, and runtime metrics.

tools.name: nastech_warmup_runtime
tools.description: Load the active local runtime and perform a short local warm-up synthesis.

tools.name: nastech_clear_runtime_cache
tools.description: Discard cached WAV responses without unloading local runtime sessions.
